bridge.notConnected: The space is not connected yet.
bridge.timeout: The request timed out. Please try again.
bridge.editorUnavailable: Unable to open the document editor.
sheet.label: Spreadsheet editor
sheet.conflict: Another member saved a newer version. Copy your edits, reload, then merge your changes.
sheet.reloadDescription: Unsaved cell changes will be discarded.
sheet.limitations: Edits preserve formulas without recalculating them. File saves use version checks; this view does not merge simultaneous edits. The grid displays up to 1,000 rows and 100 columns.
sheet.choose: Open a spreadsheet from the workspace.
workbook.collaborationHint: Independent cell edits merge on save. Conflicts preserve your draft. Connected collaborators receive saved changes immediately.
workbook.conflict: A newer version exists. Your local edits are preserved. Download local JSON before reloading, then reapply your changes to the latest version.
workbook.remoteChanged: Another member or Assistant saved a newer version. Your draft has been preserved.
workbook.indexPending: Workbook and Project source saved; catalog indexing will retry.
workbook.reloadDescription: Download local JSON first if you want to keep this draft. Reloading uses the latest committed version.
workbook.accessDenied: You no longer have access to this workbook. Your local changes have been kept.
workbook.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and access, then retry.
workbook.historyDescription: Preview a saved version. Restoring creates a new version and keeps all history.
workbook.restoreDirty: Save or download your local draft before restoring a version.
workbook.restoreDescription: This creates a new current version. If another person has saved meanwhile, restoration is rejected so their changes remain intact.
workbook.restoreFailed: Could not restore. A newer version or changed access may prevent this action. Your draft and history are preserved; refresh and retry.
workbook.selectionReferenced: Selection added to Assistant context. You can now ask about these cells.
workbook.selectionLimited: Selection referenced with explicit size limits. At most 200 cells and 32 KB of content are included; large values are marked omitted.
workbook.highlightedChanges: The latest synchronization highlights up to {{count}} changed cells for 8 seconds.
workbook.fileFidelity: XLSX keeps cells, formulas and merged ranges. Charts, images, macros, pivot tables, validation, comments and complex formatting are not preserved. Import creates a local draft; review it before saving a new version.
workbook.csvFidelity: CSV uses UTF-8 and commas. Imported values remain text to preserve precision. Export includes only the selected worksheet (or the first sheet), with formulas as text and no server recalculation.
workbook.fileLimit: Import: up to 25 MB, 100 sheets and 100,000 cells. CSV export expands at most 1,000,000 grid positions. Larger files or unsupported formats are rejected.
workbook.fileDirty: Save your local draft before importing or exporting.
workbook.fileFailed: File conversion failed. Check the format, size limits, access and current version; no saved content was replaced.
workbook.importDraft: Choose a file to import as a draft
workbook.localDraftHint: Drafts stay in this browser. Recovering requires current access to this workbook. A queued save retries its original request; conflicts keep the draft. Save or reload your current changes before recovering another draft.
workbook.noLocalDrafts: No other drafts in this browser.
workbook.localDraftSaved: Draft retained in this browser. Queued saves retry after reconnecting.
workbook.localDraftFailed: Local draft storage is unavailable or full. Keep this tab open and download a local copy before reloading.
workbook.deleteDraftHint: This removes only this browser copy. Unsaved changes in it cannot be recovered. The saved workbook is unchanged.
workbook.undoDescription: Creates a new revision that reverses your cell changes. Other cells stay unchanged. Later edits to the same cells, structure changes, or edits older than 100 revisions block undo.
workbook.undoFailed: Undo was not applied. Affected cells may have changed, or this revision cannot be undone. Refresh history and review the current version.
workbook.nativeBackupHelp: Native backups preserve workbook formatting, formulas and extension data. Restore to this workbook as a draft, then save a new revision. History and member permissions are not included.
workbook.selectionCalculationFailed: The selection changed or calculation has not completed. Please reference it again.
workbook.fileDateSystemUnsupported: The 1904 date system is not supported. Convert to the 1900 date system in the source application before importing. Saved content was not replaced.
workbook.structureHelp: Apply at the current selection and save a new version. Formula references follow row and column changes. Save existing edits first.
workbook.structureSortHelp: Reorder the entire selected rows by input values in the first selected column. References follow the original rows. Formula sort keys are unsupported.
workbook.structureDataLoss: Other cells in the merge contain content. Move or clear that content before merging.
workbook.structureUnsupported: This workbook contains formulas, extensions or disjoint references that cannot be transformed. Content was not changed. Use native editor operations and verify references before saving.
workbook.structureFailed: The operation could not be validated. Check the selection, count, sheet name and merged ranges.
workbook.busyRetry: The workbook service is busy. Your local draft is retained and pending saves will retry automatically.
